thread:
laura_ml: quick sync for GTN pilot: scorecard uploaded. recommendation = opt-7b-int4 default + opt-13b-int8 slowpath for flagged/long/premium. short rationale and numbers below.

jamie_prod: headline numbers plz (latency, $/1M tok, quality delta)

laura_ml: bullets:
- opt-7b-int4: median token latency ~9ms, 95p ~32ms; infra ~$120 / 1M tokens; quality -3.5% vs 13b-int8 on chat eval.
- opt-13b-int8: median token latency ~18ms, 95p ~65ms; infra ~$360 / 1M tokens; used for high-sensitivity prompts.
- fallback to 13b cuts user-visible regressions by ~78% for flagged set.

sanjay_research: remind me eval method

laura_ml: A/B pairwise on 8k prompt pairs, crowd preference + LLM ensemble, same decoding seeds. artifacts: https://drive.redwood/team/evals/q2-chat-scorecard

maria_gtn: what fails on 7b-int4? will it break search & summarize flows?

laura_ml: failure modes: long multi-step reasoning, rare-entity factuality, structured extraction (dates/amounts). recommend routing rules and small classifier to catch extraction prompts.

noah_infra: infra note: mixed fleet ok, but need reserved 13b slots. propose 5% canary then 25% ramp. we can emit routed_to_13b tag + traces.

laura_ml: example route config:
```
routes:
  - name: premium-slowpath
    match: "user.tier == 'paid' or prompt.len > 1024 or classifier.score > 0.8"
    model: opt-13b-int8
    fallback: opt-7b-int4
  - name: default-fast
    match: "true"
    model: opt-7b-int4
    fallback: opt-13b-int8
```

sanjay_research: econ impact if 25% to 13b?

laura_ml: calc: 100% 7b = $120 / 1M. 25% 13b -> 0.75*120 + 0.25*360 = $180 / 1M (+50%). expected decrease in refunds/QA churn offsets some cost.

jamie_prod: can we A/B retention/engagement on routing? need instrumentation + dashboards

noah_infra: will add metrics + quota throttles for canary. console will show per-request routing tag and cost breakdown.

evalbot: artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-evals/q2-chat/2380012345/artifacts.tar.gz and PDF to https://drive.redwood/team/evals/q2-chat-scorecard.pdf

deploy-bot: Canary cluster for opt-13b-int8 initiated by noah_infra at 2380012500

maria_gtn: timeline: finalize config this week, 72h 5% canary next week, then ramp if clean. will prepare comms and GTN gating metrics.

laura_ml: action items:
- laura_ml: playbook + canary dashboard (today EOD)
- noah_infra: reserve 13b slots + metrics stream (48h)
- sanjay_research: focused eval on failure buckets (48h)
- jamie_prod/maria_gtn: define rollout success metric (engagement delta or reduced refunds)

jamie_prod: thanks team, go for canary. share links when ready :thumbsup:
